summary: Arsema G Food Mart LLC is a confirmed, operational Ethiopian-specialized African grocery in Indianapolis with unusually strong operational credentials for its category — a direct container importer of Ethiopian staples (teff flour, berbere, shiro, fenugreek, finger millet) and a SNAP/EBT-authorized retailer — behind a thin mainstream digital footprint. It operates a working Square Online storefront with checkout, and its storefront-facing listings consistently show the 6667 W Washington St location with current daily hours (10:00-21:30) and phone (317) 603-3274. The 2724 W 10th St address exists only in regulatory/intelligence-layer records (INBiz principal office, SNAP registration, 2021 customs delivery) plus two stale aggregator listings on MapQuest and YellowPages that appear to have ingested it — a suppression target, not business-published drift, and a natural owner-verification conversation. No Yelp, Facebook, or BBB presence and no verifiable public reviews were found, and directory categorization is generic 'convenience store' with no African positioning. The opportunity is consolidation, positioning, and presence-building on top of already-functional infrastructure.
public_narrative: Arsema G Food Mart is an Ethiopian-focused African grocery store on West Washington Street on the west side of Indianapolis. The market imports directly from Ethiopia, stocking staples such as brown teff flour for injera, berbere red pepper blend, shiro chickpea seasoning, fenugreek, and finger millet. A SNAP/EBT-authorized retailer, the store also offers online browsing and ordering through its Square-powered web shop.
